howto: Tap the monster to hit it; beat it to earn gold and move up a level.
Hire heroes with gold: they attack for you every second, even while you are away.
Every 10th level is a boss. When you have earned enough gold, Ascend for souls that raise your damage by 5% each.
tips: Every hero you own also makes your taps 10% stronger.
Each tap has a 10% chance to CRIT for triple damage.
Golden monsters pay extra: tap them fast.
Keep killing quickly to build a Fever streak for bonus gold.
Crystals from bosses open Loot Caches full of gold.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a button and press Enter or Space. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the monster and the hire buttons

difficulty: An idle curve: monsters gain health and pay more gold every level, bosses every 10 levels have ten times the health, and each hero costs 50% more than the last.

cheats.effect: Gold rain: a big pile of gold (25 monsters' worth)
One punch: taps hit 100 times harder
Hero party: 5 of every hero join for free

features.offline-earnings: Welcome back card: gold your heroes earned while away at 50% rate, up to 8 hours
features.upgrade-tree: Five heroes from Knight to Dragon, bought one, ten or MAX at a time, plus badges
features.big-number-format: Gold and damage shown as 1.2K, 3.4M, 5.6B and beyond
features.prestige-or-next-goal: Ascend for souls (+5% damage each) with the gold needed for the next soul shown under the button
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first visit: tap, hire, bosses and ascending; replay with Learn to play
features.results: Ascended card with gold this run, level reached, best level, souls and the new multiplier
